title: Kindness Friend ABC
hook: A good boundary can be a kind choice.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D feelings storybook, expressive friendly faces and simple social-emotional tools, uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Kindness Friend ABC

creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Kindness Friend ABC a boundary-aware friendship song: kindness, patience, respect, gratitude, sharing and courage all include consent, fairness, and the right to ask for help or say no.
